description: SINOE ® - Tonnage DMA par type de déchet is published by ADEME. The table reports collected household and similar waste tonnage by waste type and department. Its stated coverage is France; odd-numbered survey years from 2009. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. The series concerns waste handled by the public service, not all commercial waste. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
